keyVerseDR: "Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my word shall not pass away." (Mk 13:31)

level1.title: Jesus Will Come Again
level1.story: Jesus said one day the sun will grow dark and the stars will fall. Then He will come with power and glory! His words will never pass away.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you be ready for Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I will be ready for You. Amen.

activity.title: Hidden symbols
activity.intro: Find the hidden symbols in the picture.

level2.title: The Coming of the Son of Man
level2.story: Jesus said that in those days the sun shall be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light. The stars shall fall, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory. He will send His angels to gather His elect from the four winds. Jesus said, "Learn a parable of the fig tree," for when its branches are tender, summer is near. He said, "Heaven and earth shall pass away, but My word shall not pass away."
level2.keyLine: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my word shall not pass away.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why shouldn't we fear the end?
What in your life will last forever?
actions: Pray for the souls in purgatory
level2.prayer: Lord, keep me ready for Your coming. Amen.

activity.title: Words that last
activity.text: Heaven and [earth] shall pass away, but My [word] shall not pass away.
